messages:
Sam (AE): heads-up — vendor sent POC order + MSA redlines. They want split billing across two legal entities and a single MSA. Need to confirm signature flow and whether we should issue two invoices or one consolidated invoice with separate line items. cc @Priya (SalesOps)

Priya (SalesOps): pls confirm legal entity names + billing addresses and whether customer will provide two PO numbers. Any special DPA asks (subprocessors list or KMS/HSM)?

Sam (AE): Entities are 'MedSys NA, Inc.' (US) and 'MedSys UK Ltd.' (GB). Customer said they'll provide two POs. No HSM asked but they requested KMS rotation language in the DPA. I'll upload the redline in a min.

contracts-bot: New file uploaded: medsys_orderform_msa_redline_may2026.pdf

Linda (Legal): action items: 1) review redline for any SLA or data residency language 2) ask customer for subprocessors list to attach to DPA 3) confirm who signs MSA (GC) vs orderform (AP). Recommend routing: MSA -> Customer GC -> our Legal; Orderform -> our Finance -> Customer AP. Need fallback signer if GC delegates.

Omar (Finance): split invoices are ok. We need separate PO numbers, billing addresses, and preferred currency per entity. UK invoices must include VAT id and VAT line. Net60 for POC acceptable if controller signs off. Also confirm whether they want EFT or wire per entity.

Priya (SalesOps): DocuSign plan suggestion:
```
Envelope 1 (MSA): Sender -> Linda (Legal) -> Customer GC
Envelope 2-US (Orderform/PO): Sender -> Omar (Finance) -> Customer AP-US
Envelope 2-UK (Orderform/PO): Sender -> Omar (Finance) -> Customer AP-UK
Link envelopes using Reference ID to tie orderforms to MSA.
```

Sam (AE): I'll ask customer for: PO numbers per entity, subprocessors list, primary + fallback signers, and payment method. Will update thread after they reply. Thanks all :thumbsup:
